blocks.html: How to check if the code follows SRP
blocks.text: How to check if the code follows SRP

blocks.html: Rule 1 — One Reason to Change
blocks.text: Rule 1 — One Reason to Change

blocks.html: A unit must have exactly one cause for modification.
blocks.text: A unit must have exactly one cause for modification.

blocks.html: Reason = specific responsibility or feature scope.
blocks.text: Reason = specific responsibility or feature scope.

blocks.html: Check: List all possible requirement changes that would require editing this unit. If more than one type of change exists, SRP is violated.
blocks.text: Check: List all possible requirement changes that would require editing this unit. If more than one type of change exists, SRP is violated.

blocks.html: Rule 2 — Responsibility Cohesion
blocks.text: Rule 2 — Responsibility Cohesion

blocks.html: All functions and data in the unit must serve the same conceptual goal.
blocks.text: All functions and data in the unit must serve the same conceptual goal.

blocks.html: Check: Group functions by purpose. If they fall into different categories (e.g., “data access” and “UI formatting”), SRP is violated.
blocks.text: Check: Group functions by purpose. If they fall into different categories (e.g., “data access” and “UI formatting”), SRP is violated.

blocks.html: Rule 3 — Stakeholder Isolation
blocks.text: Rule 3 — Stakeholder Isolation

blocks.html: Only one type of stakeholder should request changes to this unit.
blocks.text: Only one type of stakeholder should request changes to this unit.

blocks.html: Check: Identify all groups who might ask for edits. If unrelated groups appear, responsibilities are mixed.
blocks.text: Check: Identify all groups who might ask for edits. If unrelated groups appear, responsibilities are mixed.

blocks.html: Rule 4 — Change Cascade Prevention
blocks.text: Rule 4 — Change Cascade Prevention

blocks.html: Changing one part of functionality must not risk breaking unrelated functionality.
blocks.text: Changing one part of functionality must not risk breaking unrelated functionality.

blocks.html: Check: Make a hypothetical change. If unrelated tests or features need updates, SRP is violated.
blocks.text: Check: Make a hypothetical change. If unrelated tests or features need updates, SRP is violated.

blocks.html: Rule 5 — Single-Axis Testing
blocks.text: Rule 5 — Single-Axis Testing

blocks.html: Unit tests should focus on one area of behavior.
blocks.text: Unit tests should focus on one area of behavior.

blocks.html: Check: Count the different kinds of mocks/stubs needed. If more than one unrelated kind is needed, SRP is violated.
blocks.text: Check: Count the different kinds of mocks/stubs needed. If more than one unrelated kind is needed, SRP is violated.

blocks.html: Rule 6 — Naming Clarity
blocks.text: Rule 6 — Naming Clarity

blocks.html: A class or module name should describe its single purpose without “and” or multiple concepts.
blocks.text: A class or module name should describe its single purpose without “and” or multiple concepts.

blocks.html: Check: If the name contains multiple domains (e.g., “UserProfileAndLogger”), SRP is violated.
blocks.text: Check: If the name contains multiple domains (e.g., “UserProfileAndLogger”), SRP is violated.

blocks.html: Rule 7 — Feature Change Impact
blocks.text: Rule 7 — Feature Change Impact

blocks.html: A change in one feature should require modifying only one unit.
blocks.text: A change in one feature should require modifying only one unit.

blocks.html: Check: Track code changes for recent features. If one feature’s change affects unrelated files, SRP may be violated.
blocks.text: Check: Track code changes for recent features. If one feature’s change affects unrelated files, SRP may be violated.

blocks.html: Rule 8 — Dependency Domain Alignment
blocks.text: Rule 8 — Dependency Domain Alignment

blocks.html: Dependencies of a unit should all belong to the same domain.
blocks.text: Dependencies of a unit should all belong to the same domain.

blocks.html: Check: If the unit depends on unrelated systems (e.g., DB + Email API), SRP is violated.
blocks.text: Check: If the unit depends on unrelated systems (e.g., DB + Email API), SRP is violated.
